data.title: Create a MariaDB database and user
data.summary: CREATE DATABASE, CREATE USER, then GRANT — in that order.
data.body:
Database

CREATE DATABASE note_mgmnt
  CHARACTER SET utf8mb4
  COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

User and grants

CREATE USER 'app'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY 'change-me';
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON note_mgmnt.* TO 'app'@'%';
FLUSH PRIVILEGES;

Use 'app'@'localhost' instead of % when the app runs on the database host.

rules: title is trimmed and required (VALIDATION_FAILED on title), at most 200 characters.
summary is trimmed; empty becomes null. At most 1000 characters.
body is HTML from the editor. The server sanitizes it to the editor's markup; an editor with nothing typed is stored as "". At most 8,000,000 characters.
categoryId must reference an existing category or be null (VALIDATION_FAILED on categoryId).
attachmentIds must be staged attachments (noteId null) or already belong to this note (VALIDATION_FAILED on attachmentIds).
Staged images the body references (/api/attachments/:id/content) are filed under the note as embedded attachments.
